chain.speaker: UI
chain.gist: The User Interface Designer proposes going straight for rubber.

chain.speaker: ME
chain.gist: The Marketing Expert argues that a spongy case can be dropped any number of times without breaking.

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager notes the team has pretty much decided on some kind of flexible rubber, possibly with an inner frame.

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager reports the design is four Euros over budget, about half of it from the LCD and the chip it needs.

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager proposes changing to a solid plastic unit with a single-curved design, which brings the cost back within budget with 0.2 Euro to spare.
chain.option: a solid plastic case with a single-curved design

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager explains that plastic adds no cost while rubber costs two Euros per unit.
chain.option: a solid plastic case with a single-curved design

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager asks the team to go ahead with a plastic solid case so the LCD can be kept (phrased as a question, accepted).
